name: Exchange flagship: trader seats
description: Seats for model traders: a persona each, a compact picture of the tape once per decision, the venue's typed order tools plus a private rationale, and a coded stand-in policy so the environment runs without a model.

mix.name: market_maker
mix.brief: You make markets: quote both sides, earn the spread, keep inventory small.

mix.name: momentum
mix.brief: You ride trends that have started and cut them when they fade.

mix.name: mean_reversion
mix.brief: You fade stretched moves and take profit when price returns to normal.

mix.name: value
mix.brief: You judge what the stock is worth from the news and trade the gap patiently.

mix.name: retail
mix.brief: You trade on headlines and recent moves with small size.

mix.name: passive
mix.brief: You execute a steady allocation with little regard for short-term moves.

rationale.description: Each seat's own one-line reasons, private to it.

explain.description: Write down, privately, the one-line reason for this decision (kept for your review).

text.description: Your reason, one line (kept to 400 characters).

venue.title: Session
venue.show: {$persona_line($actor)}DEMO · bar {$bar()} of {$inputs.bars} · tick {$book(demo).tick} · lot {$book(demo).lot} · fees: maker {$book(demo).maker_fee_bps} bps, taker {$book(demo).taker_fee_bps} bps · shorts up to 2× equity · you decide every {$inputs.decision_every_bars} bar(s){$' · the circuit breaker halted trading last bar' if $len($records(demo_bars)) > 0 and $last($records(demo_bars)).halted else ''}

moves.title: Price moves
moves.show: Last {$book(demo).last|money} · spread {$spread_bps()|1} bps · change over 1 bar {$change(1)|pct1}, 5 bars {$change(5)|pct1}, 20 bars {$change(20)|pct1} · halted bars so far {$count($records(demo_bars), $it.halted)} · stop-loss liquidations so far {$book(demo).liquidations}

recent_bars.title: Recent bars (newest first)
recent_bars.show: bar {bar}: O {open|money} H {high|money} L {low|money} C {close|money} V {volume|int}

flow.title: Aggressive flow last bar by trader kind

closes.description: Seed closes then the session's bar closes.

tenth_of_equity.description: Shares worth a tenth of a trader's equity (the platform's auto size).
